comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Hey @zgabi! 👋

Thanks again for catching this — and for the screenshots, they made it very easy to pinpoint the problem!

**Root cause:** The `PictureBox` controls in the confirmation dialog had no `SizeMode` set (defaults to `Normal`, which clips the image instead of scaling it). On Windows 11 with DPI scaling, the system icon bitmap can be larger than the 32×32 PictureBox, so it gets clipped at the edges.

**Fix (commit d08f79fd2):** Set `PictureBoxSizeMode.Zoom` on both `imgMain` (32×32) and ...
